title: Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-pass primitive decoders such as LocateAnything and VFlash predict all quantized coordinate tokens of a geometric primitive in one forward pass, enabling fast, System-1 visual planning. We study what matters when such a decoder serves as a System-1 world model: a fast action-conditioned predictor that ranks candidate pushes by their predicted outcome. On ManiSkill3 PushT-v1 (512 held-out test families, 8,192 rollouts) and on human demonstrations from lerobot/pusht (2,384 test windows), we compare decoders, training losses, rigid-body projections and coordinate frames, using matched checkpoints, hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm correction. Two factors of similar size dominate. First, expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose lowers decision regret by 1.9-2.2x for each of five decoders, and the object-frame model trained on 128 families matches the world-frame model trained on

translated_title: 先定坐标系，一次解码：面向System-1世界模型的以物体为中心坐标与单遍解码
translated_abstract: 诸如LocateAnything和VFlash等单遍基元解码器能够在一次前向传播中预测几何基元的所有量化坐标标记，从而实现快速的系统1（System-1）视觉规划。我们研究了当这样的解码器充当系统1世界模型——即一个根据预测结果对候选推挤动作进行排序的快速动作条件预测器——时，究竟哪些因素最为关键。在ManiSkill3 PushT-v1（512个留出测试族，8,192次 rollout）以及来自lerobot/pusht的人类演示数据（2,384个测试窗口）上，我们使用匹配的检查点、分层自助法置信区间和Holm校正，比较了不同的解码器、训练损失、刚体投影和坐标系。两个影响程度相近的因素起主导作用。第一，在物体初始位姿的SE(2)坐标系中表达输入和输出，可使五个解码器中每一个的决策遗憾降低1.9-2.2倍，并且仅用128个族训练的物体坐标系模型即可与在世界坐标系下训练的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过系统消融实验发现，在基于单遍解码的系统1世界模型中，采用以物体初始位姿SE(2)坐标系为中心的坐标表达是主导性因素，可将决策遗憾降低1.9-2.2倍，并大幅减少所需训练数据。
en_tdlr: Expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose is the dominant factor for single-pass-decoding System-1 world models, reducing decision regret by 1.9–2.2x across five decoders while enabling data-efficient training.
